verification.notes: FBIAA's current organizational profile confirms a 1981 founding and a mission to advance and safeguard active and retired agents' professional interests. It currently says more than 13,000 rather than 14,000 members and describes a nonprofit professional association rather than simply a charity, so the statement is substantially but not fully accurate.
